rationale: Held text (79 FR 42971) confirms sections 1-5 of EO 13672. Held EO 14173 (90 FR 8633, signed 2025-01-21) section 3(a)(iii) revokes EO 13672 by name with no delay; the 90-day contractor window in 3(b)(i) attaches only to the EO 11246 revocation, as the decision says. An express revocation by name supplies the reason every clause ended. The open question of whether the substituted wording survives in EO 11478's text is honestly retained as a lifecycle gap, and the U.S. Code note is correctly treated as editorial.
